description: MtaStsError::PolicyIdMismatch { cached, dns } is defined in mta_sts_error.rs and has a Display impl, but no code path in mta_sts_dns.rs, mta_sts_fetcher.rs, relay_client.rs, or anywhere else ever constructs it. In relay_client.rs, policy rotation is handled by discarding the stale entry and re-fetching — the mismatch is logged via warn! not surfaced as MtaStsError. Either wire the variant into the policy-rotation path (replace the remove+re-fetch log with an Err return that callers handle), or delete the variant and its Display arm.
title: MtaStsError::PolicyIdMismatch is never constructed — dead variant
